sloka: ततः कौतूहलात् रामो लक्ष्मणः च महारथः ।मुनिम् धर्मभृतम् नाम प्रष्टुम् समुपचक्रमे ॥३-११-८॥
transliteration: tataḥ kautūhalāt rāmo lakṣmaṇaḥ ca mahārathaḥ ।munim dharmabhṛtam nāma praṣṭum samupacakrame ॥3-11-8॥

translations.english: Out of curiosity, mighty Rama, and Lakshmana started enquiring about the matter from sage Dharmabrata by name:
